items.quote: the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, “He is related to us.”
items.contrast: The citizens of Shechem say Abimelek is related to them; the brothers merely repeat information to the citizens.
items.reason: The pronouns “they” and “us” refer to the citizens of Shechem, so the key identifies the speakers uniquely. Resolving the pronoun antecedent distinguishes the citizens from the brothers.
